name: 9Router
author: admin@example.com
description: 9Router: AI router and token saver. One OpenAI-compatible endpoint with auto-fallback across subscription, cheap and free providers, plus a web dashboard.

variables.name: Dashboard Password
variables.description: Password for the first dashboard login. Change it again inside the dashboard afterwards.

variables.name: Require API Key
variables.description: Require a Bearer API key on /v1/* routes. Keep true when the port is public.

variables.name: Secure Auth Cookie
variables.description: Set true only when the dashboard is served over HTTPS through a reverse proxy.
